$comment: Refunds of gifts (decision D-refunds-2). Rock stores a refund as a new transaction with negative amounts, linked to the gift in FinancialTransactionRefund, and refuses a refund of a refund, of a foreign currency gift, or of more than was paid. Generated households get refunds at the profile's giving.refundsPerThousandGifts; perThousandGiftsWithoutProfile is the rate only when the profile has none. The Cast's refunds are designed in their household files. Each kind names one of Rock's shipped refund reasons, its share of refunds, and how many days after the gift staff refund it; a refund that would fall on a weekend, Christmas Day, or New Year's Day comes the next weekday. duplicate and earlier-year refund the whole gift, and incorrect-amount and one-fund refund part of it, so 35% of refunds are partial. A summary is what staff typed in Rock's refund dialog, and can say {intended}, {entered}, {refunded}, {fund}, and {kept}. A duplicate of a scheduled gift, given again by hand later that day, takes its summary from scheduledSummaries.
